name: Facets Short Pretty Paths
description: Shortens the pretty-path facet URLs produced by Facets Pretty Paths.
project_description: Shortens the pretty-path URLs produced by the Facets Pretty Paths module. It provides a "Short pretty paths" Facets URL processor that writes each facet's alias only once and joins multiple active values for that facet with a dot delimiter, and a "Taxonomy term machine name" pretty-paths coder that emits a term's machine name (with a fallback to a cleaned term name plus its id when no machine name is set) instead of the term id. So a three-value colour filter becomes /color/black.yellow.red instead of /color/black-1/color/yellow-2/color/red-3. A route subscriber appends the {facets_query} path parameter to facet-source routes configured to use this processor, and an overriding active-filters service decodes those shortened path segments back into active facet selections. It depends on Facets Pretty Paths and, for term uniqueness, optionally on the Taxonomy Machine Name module; the taxonomy field used for path resolution defaults to 'machine_name' and can be overridden via $settings['facets_short_pretty_paths_field_name'], with $settings['facets_short_pretty_paths_use_dashes'] switching machine names to dashes for SEO. It changes the form of facet URLs only, not access or which results are returned.
